reviewDescription: An honest review from someone with sensory issues and is prone to sensory overload. I’ve been using these earbuds for over two years now and have since bought a second pair just to have on hand. (Actually, this was my original back up pair cuz after leaving the case in an Uber, my two earbuds shared one case for several months until I finally lost my first pair while moving.) Battery life is about seven hours; when the case is at full battery it will charge your earbuds from dead to full twice. Both charge to full in about 30 minutes, more or less. I’ve never had a problem with the quality of music, and I also love the bass mode. These are also the comfiest earbuds I own— I often wear them for the full seven hours straight and my ears don’t hurt when I take them out; I barely even notice that I’m wearing them They stay in place well and never fall out unless I have them loose to hear better. (They are a little bulky, so I don’t remember sleeping with them in.) Whenever I have sensory overload, I put these on and instantly feel ten times better. I experience very little connectivity issues, even after two years of using them nearly every single day. I’ve had three pairs and never had the infamous bluetooth earbud problem where one randomly disconnects and never pairs again. And finally, the reason I wrote the review: I dropped one of them in the toilet last night and put it in the sink while I washed my hands. It smells funny now obviously so I’ll probably buy a new back-up pair, but it actually still works!! If you have sensory issues and are prone to sensory overloads, these are perfect.

reviewDescription: Up until a month ago, these were decent earbuds; they fit my ears fairly well, the case is small, and they were lightweight. The issues with them were that even when they were in the case, they would constantly connect to my phone. The final straw was a month ago when one of them stopped charging. I contacted the company, and since these were purchased in April of 2024, all they can do is offer me a discount to purchase them again. I went back to the earbuds I had that worked previously perfectly, but just don't fit my ears as well.
